---
title: "Province explorer"
subtitle: "Coverage, drive times and rankings for Iran's provinces"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source("dashboard/_common.R")
pm <- if (atlas_ready) fread(file.path(web_dir, "downloads", "province_metrics.csv"), encoding = "UTF-8") else data.table()
dist <- if (atlas_ready) fread(file.path(web_dir, "downloads", "province_travel_time_distribution.csv"), encoding = "UTF-8") else data.table()
thr <- if (atlas_ready) atlas_summary$thresholds else c(15, 30, 60, 120)
ref <- if (atlas_ready) atlas_summary$reference_threshold else 60
cats <- atlas_summary$categories
```

```{r}
#| label: ojs-data
#| echo: false
ojs_define(
  ready = atlas_ready,
  provinces = pm,
  dists = dist,
  thresholds = thr,
  ref = ref,
  palette = if (atlas_ready) cats$color else character()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: no-data
#| output: asis
if (!atlas_ready) not_built()
```

## Pick a province

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
prov = ready ? transpose(provinces) : []
dist = ready ? transpose(dists) : []
defaultProv = prov.some(d => d.province === "Tehran") ? "Tehran" : (prov[0] || {}).province
viewof province = Inputs.select(prov.map(d => d.province).sort(), {label: "Province", value: defaultProv})
viewof threshold = Inputs.radio(thresholds, {label: "Threshold (minutes)", value: ref})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sel = prov.find(d => d.province === province)
fmtPct = x => (x === null || x === undefined) ? "-" : `${Math.round(100 * x)}%`
fmtMin = x => (x === null || x === undefined) ? "-" : `${Math.round(x)} min`
fmtNum = x => (x === null || x === undefined) ? "-" : Math.round(x).toLocaleString("en-US")
ready && sel ? html`<div class="kpi-grid">
  <div class="kpi"><span class="kpi-label">Within ${threshold} min</span><span class="kpi-value">${fmtPct(sel["share_within_" + threshold])}</span><span class="kpi-sub">${fmtNum(sel["pop_within_" + threshold])} of ${fmtNum(sel.population)} people</span></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span class="kpi-label">Mean drive</span><span class="kpi-value">${fmtMin(sel.mean_travel_time_min)}</span><span class="kpi-sub">median ${fmtMin(sel.median_travel_time_min)}</span></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span class="kpi-label">Hospitals mapped</span><span class="kpi-value">${fmtNum(sel.n_hospitals)}</span><span class="kpi-sub">${(sel.hospitals_per_100k ?? 0).toFixed(1)} per 100k people</span></div>
  <div class="kpi"><span class="kpi-label">Rank at ${ref} min</span><span class="kpi-value">${sel.rank_coverage} / ${prov.length}</span><span class="kpi-sub">1 = best coverage</span></div>
</div>` : html``
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
colorFor = m => { const i = thresholds.findIndex(t => m < t); return palette[i === -1 ? thresholds.length : i]; }
ready ? Plot.plot({
  height: 280,
  marginLeft: 60,
  style: {fontFamily: "IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif", fontSize: "14px", background: "transparent"},
  color: {type: "identity"},
  x: {label: "Drive time to nearest hospital (minutes) →", domain: [0, 190]},
  y: {label: "↑ People", grid: true, tickFormat: "s"},
  marks: [
    Plot.rectY(dist.filter(d => d.province === province), {
      x1: "bin_start", x2: d => d.bin_end ?? 190, y: "population",
      fill: d => colorFor(d.bin_start), inset: 1
    }),
    Plot.ruleX([threshold], {stroke: "#13204A", strokeWidth: 2, strokeDasharray: "4,3"}),
    Plot.ruleY([0])
  ]
}) : html``
```

## Province ranking

Share of each province's population within the selected drive time. Switch thresholds with the buttons.

```{r}
#| label: ranking
#| eval: !expr atlas_ready
library(plotly)
thr_cols <- paste0("share_within_", thr)
rk <- copy(pm)
setorderv(rk, paste0("share_within_", ref))
p <- plot_ly(height = 24 * nrow(rk) + 140)
for (i in seq_along(thr)) {
  p <- add_bars(
    p,
    x = round(100 * rk[[thr_cols[i]]], 1), y = rk$province, orientation = "h",
    name = paste(thr[i], "min"), visible = thr[i] == ref,
    marker = list(color = "#1F3A93"),
    hovertemplate = paste0("%{y}<br>%{x:.0f}% within ", thr[i], " min<extra></extra>")
  )
}
buttons <- lapply(seq_along(thr), function(i) {
  list(method = "restyle", args = list("visible", as.list(seq_along(thr) == i)), label = paste(thr[i], "min"))
})
p |>
  layout(
    updatemenus = list(list(
      type = "buttons", direction = "right", x = 0, y = 1, xanchor = "left", yanchor = "bottom",
      showactive = TRUE, active = which(thr == ref) - 1, buttons = buttons
    )),
    xaxis = list(title = "Population within threshold", range = c(0, 100), ticksuffix = "%", fixedrange = TRUE),
    yaxis = list(title = "", categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = rk$province, fixedrange = TRUE, automargin = TRUE),
    margin = list(l = 8, r = 8, t = 56, b = 48),
    font = list(family = "IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif", size = 14, color = "#1B2233"),
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    showlegend = FALSE, bargap = 0.25
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE, responsive = TRUE)
```

## How each province's population splits by drive time

```{r}
#| label: distribution
#| eval: !expr atlas_ready
library(echarts4r)
labs <- cats$label
bands <- data.frame(province = rk$province)
prev <- 0
for (i in seq_along(thr)) {
  cur <- rk[[thr_cols[i]]]
  bands[[labs[i]]] <- round(100 * (cur - prev), 1)
  prev <- cur
}
bands[[labs[length(thr) + 1]]] <- round(100 * (rk$population_reachable / rk$population - prev), 1)
bands[[labs[length(thr) + 2]]] <- round(100 * rk$population_unreachable / rk$population, 1)
ch <- bands |> e_charts(province, height = 24 * nrow(bands) + 160)
for (s in labs) ch <- e_bar_(ch, s, stack = "share")
ch |>
  e_flip_coords() |>
  e_color(cats$color) |>
  e_x_axis(max = 100, axisLabel = list(formatter = "{value}%")) |>
  e_grid(left = 8, right = 16, top = 16, bottom = 72, containLabel = TRUE) |>
  e_legend(bottom = 0, type = "scroll") |>
  e_tooltip(trigger = "axis", axisPointer = list(type = "shadow")) |>
  e_text_style(fontFamily = "IBM Plex Sans")
```

## All provinces

```{r}
#| label: table
#| eval: !expr atlas_ready
tab <- data.frame(Rank = pm$rank_coverage, Province = pm$province, Population = fmt_int(pm$population))
for (t in thr) tab[[paste0("\u2264 ", t, " min")]] <- fmt_pct(pm[[paste0("share_within_", t)]])
tab[["Mean"]] <- fmt_min(pm$mean_travel_time_min)
tab[["Median"]] <- fmt_min(pm$median_travel_time_min)
tab[["Hospitals"]] <- pm$n_hospitals
knitr::kable(tab[order(tab$Rank), ], row.names = FALSE, align = c("r", "l", rep("r", ncol(tab) - 2)))
```
